Year Picker

The Year Picker offers a 4×3 grid of twelve years around the current one. Chevrons page through the decades.

Basic Year Picker

Open the field, click a year. The current year is tinted; your pick gets a solid fill.

Pick a year.

HTML
<div class="zak-year-picker">
    <button type="button" class="zak-year-field">
        Select year
    </button>
    <div class="zak-year-popup">
        <div class="zak-calendar-header">
            <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn">&lt;</button>
            <span class="zak-calendar-title">2026–2031</span>
            <button class="zak-calendar-nav-btn">&gt;</button>
        </div>
        <div class="zak-year-grid"><!-- year cells --></div>
    </div>
</div>

Decade Paging

The chevrons move the whole grid by six years, keeping roughly a centered window: 2024–2031 becomes 2018–2025, then 2012–2019, and so on.

HTML
<script>
    var anchor = new Date().getFullYear();
    var step = 6;                       // half a window

    prev.onclick = function () { anchor -= step; render(); };
    next.onclick = function () { anchor += step; render(); };

    function render() {
        rangeLabel.textContent = (anchor - 2) + ' \u2013 ' + (anchor + 3);
        grid.innerHTML = '';
        for (var i = anchor - 2; i <= anchor + 3; i++) {
            Cell = yearCell(i);
            grid.appendChild(Cell);
        }
    }
</script>

Disabled Years

Filter years that fall outside license or service windows so the picker itself enforces the rule.

HTML
// During render:
if (year < minYear || year > maxYear || year === 2025) {
    cell.disabled = true;
}

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-year-picker    /* Relative wrapper (field + popup) */
.zak-year-field     /* Readable trigger */
.zak-year-popup     /* Popup holding grid (hidden until active) */
.zak-year-grid      /* 4-by-3 year grid */
.zak-year-cell      /* Single year button */
.zak-year-cell.zak-selected  /* Chosen year */
.zak-year-cell.zak-current   /* Current year */
.zak-year-cell:disabled      /* Unselectable years */

// Reused:
.zak-calendar-header, .zak-calendar-title, .zak-calendar-nav-btn
.zak-btn, .zak-btn-primary, .zak-btn-sm

// Toggle class:
.zak-year-popup-active      /* Shows the popup */

JavaScript

HTML
// No library module — mirror the Month Picker loop:

var selected = null;

function yearCell(y) {
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.type = 'button';
    b.className = 'zak-year-cell';
    b.textContent = y;
    var now = new Date().getFullYear();
    if (y === now) b.classList.add('zak-current');
    if (selected === y) b.classList.add('zak-selected');
    b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        selected = y;
        field.textContent = y;
        render();
    });
    return b;
}

Accessibility

  • Year cells are native <button> elements; paging chevrons are buttons too.
  • The header label doubles as the live region — it always names the visible window.
  • Disabled years should use disabled so keyboard and screen-reader users skip them.
  • For reports or filters, a Year Picker is the right grain; link to Month/Date variants when finer control is needed.
